title: Selective synthesis of α,β-unsaturated aldehydes from allylic alcohols using oxidatively supplied hydrogen peroxide from electrochemical two-electron water oxidation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4369-4376
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08368G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yoshihiro Kon, Yuka Kimishima, Kazuhisa Murata, Kazuhiro Sayama
This paper highlights the selective oxidation of allylic alcohols to α,β-unsaturated aldehydes using hydrogen peroxide that is oxidatively supplied from the electrochemical two-electron water oxidation of an aqueous carbonate solution.
